description: Manage PROJECT_DECISIONS.md — a structured log of decisions made during meetings, extracted from 02.Meetings/summaries/ using the Anthropic API. File is organised by date (newest first), with categories as sub-sections under each date: architectural, technical, team management, project management, process, security & compliance, and cost & governance. Supports backfill (process all existing summaries), processing individual files, manual add, show by date/category, and keyword search. Use when asked to "extract decisions from meetings", "update project decisions", "what was decided about X", "add a decision", "show decisions", "backfill decisions", or invokes /project-decisions.
